synopsis: During the week of September 21 to 27, 2026, the Select Board held a special meeting to finalize articles for the upcoming special town meeting. The board voted to support revised warrant articles regarding two-family housing and an irrigation project, while declining to support a trail cleanup article. Members also approved appointments to the Southborough Cultural Arts Council and continued a discussion on financial policies and non-disclosure agreements to October.

highlights.title: Special Town Meeting Warrant Revised
highlights.why: The Select Board reopened the warrant for the October 17 special town meeting to vote on revised text, unanimously supporting articles on two-family housing and an irrigation project, but declining to support an article on trail cleanup.

highlights.title: Financial Policies Review Continued
highlights.why: The board reviewed proposed updates to financial policies regarding non-disclosure agreements for procurement processes and agreed to postpone final review to the October 6 meeting.

highlights.title: Cultural Arts Council Appointments Approved
highlights.why: The board approved two returning members to the Southborough Cultural Arts Council, which enables the group to receive and distribute state grant funds.

looking_ahead.what: Select Board meeting covering financial policies and Breakneck Hill debt reduction
